main_measure.name: excess forward 20-bar return while short (vs all-bar window mean), non-overlapping blocks

statistic.name: t of the mean excess across short blocks

main_measure.threshold: confirm if excess < 0 with t <= -2 and slope not positive; reject if excess > 0 with t >= +2; otherwise inconclusive; inconclusive if fewer than 6 short blocks (120 short bars)

supporting_check.name: slope of forward 20-bar return on |forecast| within short bars (should be <= 0); share of short blocks with negative excess

reading: Each short block's excess is its forward 20-bar return (grid bars 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with forecast < 0) minus the mean forward 20-bar return over all bars of its own window, tested by the ordinary t of the mean. The minimum counts require both 6 short blocks and 120 short bars. The slope regresses forward 20-bar return on |forecast| over all short bars.
